name: ped-downed-kerb
note: PO 10-09 frame (L2 street, a bitten civilian lying by the kerb): two pedestrians are bitten by the D-GROVE main-street kerb (0.28 m step at z 5.4, between two parked cars): one falls across the step, one on the road as reference. Look for: the lying bodies rest on the paving / road surface (no floating gap under the torso or legs, no sinking into the kerb).
